auto_connect.title: 🔄 Auto Connect
auto_connect.description: Automatically connect to ESP32 when app starts

tips.title: 💡 Quick Tips
tips.tip1: Make sure your phone and ESP32 are on the same WiFi network
tips.tip2: ESP32 IP address can be found in Serial Monitor
tips.tip3: You can also use "agrirobot.local" if MDNS is enabled
